# Person

Used directly by: [`getPerson`](../operations/getPerson.md), [`updatePerson`](../operations/updatePerson.md), [`findPerson`](../operations/findPerson.md), [`findOrCreatePerson`](../operations/findOrCreatePerson.md), [`createPerson`](../operations/createPerson.md)

A person record: returned by GET /people/{vanId}, as the items of GET /people, and as what a redirect-following client lands on after the write endpoints. A few fields read differently between get-by-id and search — see `formalSalutation` and `formalEnvelopeName`.

The properties listed below with no type were only ever observed as null, either because the section needs `$expand` or because the sandbox committee holds no such data. They are listed to document that the API returns them, but their shape is unverified.

| Property | Type | Notes |

| `firstName` | string or null |  |
| `lastName` | string or null |  |

| `suffix` | string or null |  |
| `title` | string or null |  |
| `contactSource` | string | How the person record entered the database, e.g. "API". |
| `contactMode` | string | Defaults to "Person" even on a blank person record; an unrecognized written value is stored as "Person". One of: `Person`, `Organization`. |
| `salutation` | string or null |  |
| `formalSalutation` | string or null | On GET /people/{vanId}, derived from the name — "Friend" when there is no name to derive from, unlike `salutation`, which is null in that case. Always null in GET /people search results, even for people where get-by-id derives a value. |
| `envelopeName` | string or null |  |
| `formalEnvelopeName` | string or null | On GET /people/{vanId}, derived from the name — "Our Friend At" when there is no name to derive from, unlike `envelopeName`, which is null in that case. Always null in GET /people search results, even for people where get-by-id derives a value. |

| `partialDateOfBirth` | object or null | The birth date broken into components; null when dateOfBirth is null. Returned by both GET /people and GET /people/{vanId}. e.g. `{'year': 2001, 'month': 11, 'day': 23}` |
